{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.92

|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= Groups

|gr2= AI Behaviour

|descr= Sets individual unit behaviour on every unit in a group and additionally tries to force this behaviour to the unit's group. Alternatively see [[setCombatBehaviour]].
{{Feature|informative|See [[AI Behaviour]] for details of the effect of this command on AI units.}}
<spoiler text="Comparison of Behaviour commands">
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center"
! Command
! Applies To
|-
| [[setBehaviour]]
| '''Every unit''' in the group, but '''not the group''' itself
|-
| [[setBehaviourStrong]]
| '''Every unit''' in the group, and the '''group''' itself
|-
| [[setCombatBehaviour]]
| If argument is [[Object]], only that '''unit''', and if argument is [[Group]], the '''group''' itself (not its units)
|}
</spoiler>

|s1= groupName [[setBehaviourStrong]] behaviour

|p1= groupName: [[Group]] or [[Object]] - unit from the group

|p2= behaviour: [[String]] - can be one of:
* "CARELESS"
* "SAFE"
* "AWARE"
* "COMBAT"
* "STEALTH"

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_group1 setBehaviourStrong "SAFE";</sqf>

|seealso= [[setCombatBehaviour]] [[combatBehaviour]] [[AIBehaviour]] [[behaviour]] [[setBehaviour]] [[setWaypointBehaviour]] [[combatMode]] [[setCombatMode]] [[skill]] [[setSkill]] [[Arma 3: AI Skill]]
}}
